title: Shipping cost in a codebase organized by domain
expectation: The code is split by domain folder (inventory, shipping, billing). Without guidance the agent may put the new function in a utils or helpers file, or outside the shipping folder.
prompt: Add a function that computes the shipping cost of an order from its total weight in kilograms: up to 1 kg costs 500 cents, up to 5 kg costs 900 cents, and above 5 kg it is 900 cents plus 200 cents for each further whole or partial kg. Add tests.

checks.pattern: not in the one obvious place
not in the one obvious place
